description.text: There are A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H, altogether 8 levels of Chinese Learning courses in HEU, in which every level being more progressive than another, each being a seperate unit. In the process of teaching, the teachers not only lay stress on the intensifying communicative competence and training reading skills, and also the promoting the students' comprehensive Chinese ability. The students will attend different classes according to their demand and Chinese ability. Curricula Introduction Compulsory courses: Comprehensive Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese reading, Chinese writing, Chinese character reading and writing, Chinese conversation, etc. Elective courses: HSK guidance(elementary & intermediate advanced), modern Chinese pronunciation, economic and trade newspapers reading, business spoken Chinese, Guzheng (zither), Tai Chi, etc. Length of Schooling One semester, which needs to complete the task of studying for 18 weeks, including 17 teaching weeks, a week for exams. Spring Semester: from early March to early July Application Time Spring Semester: January 10th

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Program at Harbin Engineering University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 847 USD/In total ￥ 6100 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: The healthy foreign citizens above 16 years old
